verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean centred column with the logo centred and the CTA given breathing room, but the sale ribbon now sits below the bottle and is shrunk to a minor tag, and the legal line is almost as large as the body copy, which flattens the hierarchy. B pushes the tiny logo off-axis to the top right and runs the ribbon off the left edge. Its headline leaves 'last' orphaned on its own line, the body copy strands 'June 21.', the legal text is again nearly body-sized, and the oversized CTA crowds the sides and sits cramped near the bottom edge.
